patch.title: 在相关工作的 INSERT 标记处插入一段可穿戴设备隐私风险综述，引用文献库中的三篇论文（park2021、liu2022、gao2023）。

hunks.newText: Wearable devices continuously capture sensitive health and behavioral data, which raises significant privacy concerns for users. Prior work has examined these privacy risks in wearable sensing \cite{park2021,liu2022,gao2023}, highlighting the need for privacy-preserving designs in continuous health monitoring.
